ideas.title: Appraise for Cash
ideas.hook: A sealed rock rolls onto the table. Everyone guesses what it's worth, then it gets cracked open on camera. The closest guess takes the pot.
core_loop: Inspect a sealed rock for 10 seconds (weight, glow, cracks)
Lock in a price guess
Watch the rock crack open live
Closest guess wins the pot; bank cash to buy better magnifiers
ideas.twist: Players can bid to buy the rock before it opens, so a bluffing guess can trick others into overpaying for a dud.
monetization: VIP pass with a bigger daily pot
retention: Head-to-head rounds against the whole server
Rock index that fills as you see each rare core
ideas.why_now: Quiz × money is a top-5 gap (score 6.59) and quiz × stones scores 4.93. Stones/rocks is the second-fastest theme at 2.82× (+1 Stone Skipping 53.2K CCU, Lift Rock For Eggs 13.9K at 13 days), money is at 2.2×, and quiz/guess is rising at 1.22× with Is It Verity? and Guess The Real Size! under 30 days old.
ideas.differentiator: Guess games ask for one right answer; here the answer is a real cash value and the reveal is a dig-style crack, so every round ends with a payout moment.

ideas.title: +1 Hair Length
ideas.hook: Every step you take grows your hair by +1. Walk far enough and it trails behind you for miles, then style it for the runway.
core_loop: Walk or run to gain +1 hair length per step
Spend length at the salon on styles, colours and clips
Enter the hourly runway where the longest, best-styled hair wins
Rebirth to grow faster with a new base style
ideas.twist: Your hair is physical: other players can trip on it, and you can tie it to things to swing across gaps into new zones.
ideas.why_now: +1 × fashion is a strong open gap (score 6.31). The +1 mechanic is at 2.41× and the "+1 ___" title formula at 2.59× (+1 Stone Skipping 53.2K CCU, [☁️WORLD 2] +1 Tongue Escape😛 20.3K). Fashion is rising at 1.65× led by Makeup Mania! BETA [LASH TECH UPDATE] at 33.6K CCU after 15 days.
ideas.differentiator: Tongue Escape grows a body part for an obby; here the stat is a fashion item you style and show off, which pulls in the dress-up crowd.

ideas.title: Pull for Supercars
ideas.hook: Open card packs to pull car parts: engine, body, wheels. Snap a full set together and the supercar is yours to race.
core_loop: Earn coins driving laps
Open part packs (each card is a rarity-tiered part)
Complete a car set to unlock and drive it
Race other players for better packs
ideas.twist: Mixed sets work too: a common body on a mythic engine drives fast but looks wild, and odd combos fill a hidden 'franken-car' index.
retention: Garage plot to show off your fleet
ideas.why_now: Dice × vehicles is a 6.23-score gap. Dice/cards is rising at 2.15× ([🎉 UPD 7] Anime Dice 56K CCU at 56 days) and collect/index at 2.31×. Vehicle games keep pulling players: Steal A Car at 12.2K and Kukirin Life [Testing] at 16.9K are both under 60 days old.
ideas.differentiator: Car games sell whole cars; here you collect cars part by part from packs, so every pull moves you toward a car you can drive straight away.

ideas.title: Fire VS Ice Cards
ideas.hook: The server splits into Fire and Ice. Collect element cards, play them on a shared battlefield, and melt or freeze the other side's territory.
core_loop: Open element packs and build a 6-card hand
Join a lane battle: play cards to push fire or ice across the map
Captured ground drops shards for new cards
Fuse duplicates into stronger cards
ideas.twist: The map really changes: fire turns ice tiles into water, ice freezes lava into walkways, so the whole server sees which side is winning.
retention: Personal card den to display rares
ideas.why_now: Dice × ice/fire is an open gap (score 6.0). Ice/fire/elements is rising at 1.81× (Firefighting Sim 🚒 26.4K CCU at 18 days, Melt All The Ice!🧊 5.5K) and the "___ vs ___" title formula is up 2.43× (Ball VS Ball 53.6K, Bunker vs Verity 20.2K).
ideas.differentiator: Anime Card Clash is 1v1 card duels; this is a server-wide team war where every played card visibly melts or freezes the shared map.

ideas.title: Trap for Zombies
ideas.hook: Set traps at night to catch zombies alive. Each one you catch goes in your zombie index and gets put to work on your base by day.
core_loop: Place nets, pits and cages around your plot before night
Catch zombies as they wander in (rarer ones break weak traps)
Log them in the index and assign them to base jobs
Spend earnings on stronger traps for rarer zombies
ideas.twist: Escaped zombies wander into neighbours' plots, so a rare one you lost can be caught by someone else.
ideas.why_now: Collect × zombies is a 4.91-score gap. Collect/index is at 2.31× momentum, and zombies is rising at 1.31× (Build and Kill Zombies 20.5K CCU, ✈️ Zombie Air Force 2.9K at 16 days). Survive × tycoon is one of the strongest pairs (6 young games, 48.6K CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Zombie games are about killing them; here zombies are collectibles you catch and keep, borrowing the steal-a-creature loop for a survival theme.

ideas.title: Build a Firework Show
ideas.hook: Design your own fireworks by drawing the burst pattern, then launch a full show over your plot. The crowd pays for every gasp.
core_loop: Draw a burst shape and pick colours on a pixel grid
Load shells onto launch racks
Run a timed show while visitors watch
Ticket cash buys bigger racks and new effects
ideas.twist: Players vote live on each show; top-voted designs get added to a server-wide finale everyone sees at the top of the hour.
monetization: Speed pass for faster rack reloads
ideas.why_now: Paint × ice/fire is an open gap (score 5.78). Paint/create is rising at 2.07× (Paint to Get Rich 🎨 31.8K CCU), hit/launch at 1.67×, and the "Build a ___" title formula at 1.45× (Build the Pyramid! 20.4K CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Firework sandboxes let you set off preset rockets; here you draw every burst yourself and earn from a crowd, like Paint to Get Rich but in the sky.

ideas.title: Curl for Gold
ideas.hook: Slide a curling stone down a long frozen lane. Sweep to gain +1 speed and the stone slides further, past rings of gold coins.
core_loop: Push the stone off
Spam sweep for +1 speed per stroke
The stone stops on a prize ring (farther rings pay more)
Buy heavier stones that keep momentum longer
ideas.twist: Stones you knock off the lane are collectibles: rare ones drop from other players' shots, so a busy lane pays more.
retention: Zone unlocks further down the ice
ideas.why_now: Stones/rocks is up 2.82× and +1 Stone Skipping (53.2K CCU at 35 days) proves the 'throw a stone for distance' loop. Hit/swing is at 1.67×, sports at 1.64× (Ball VS Ball 53.6K) and ice/fire at 1.81× (Melt All The Ice!🧊 5.5K).
ideas.differentiator: Stone Skipping is one throw over water; curling adds a skill layer (sweeping) on top of the stat, and the frozen lane fits a winter season.

ideas.title: Wreck for Mech Parts
ideas.hook: Giant broken robots lie across the map. Smash them apart for parts, then bolt those parts onto your own mech and fight.
core_loop: Pick a wreck and smash it with your tool
Collect armour, arms, cores (rarity tiered)
Assemble and upgrade your mech in the garage
Pilot it in boss raids for rarer wrecks
ideas.twist: Every part you equip shows on your mech, so a player who smashed a mythic boss wreck walks around with its glowing arm.
retention: Offline smashing drones on your base
ideas.why_now: Break × robots/mechs is an open gap (score 4.89). Break/mine/dig is the fastest-rising mechanic at 3.07× (Break and Steal an Egg 156.6K CCU, (🩸) Drill for Eggs 21.5K at 24 days), forge/craft is at 1.69× ([BOSS]+1 Loot To Forge 45.7K), and the fight × forge pair is already proven at 45.7K CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Mech games hand you a mech; here you salvage it from the world piece by piece, so the smashing loop feeds the fighting loop.

ideas.title: Build a Fashion House
ideas.hook: Start with one sewing table. Design clothes, sell them to shoppers, and grow a tiny workshop into a full fashion house with its own show.
core_loop: Design a piece by picking a cut, colour and pattern
Shoppers browse your racks and buy what fits their taste
Cash buys new rooms: dye lab, fitting rooms, show hall
Host a fashion show; good reviews bring richer shoppers
ideas.twist: Other players can model your designs in your show, and their outfit ratings boost your shop's fame.
ideas.why_now: Fashion is rising at 1.65× (Makeup Mania! BETA [LASH TECH UPDATE] 33.6K CCU at 15 days, Dress Designer 6.1K at 16 days) and tycoon/base building at 1.85×. Interiors are the second-fastest map style at 1.65×, and the "Build a ___" formula is up 1.45×.
ideas.differentiator: Fashion games are one-round dress-ups; this turns designing into a tycoon you keep growing, with a show hall that brings other players in.

ideas.title: Smelt for Eggs
ideas.hook: Mine ore, melt it down, and pour it into an egg mould. The metal you use decides what hatches: iron gives golems, gold gives dragons.
core_loop: Mine ore in the quarry zones
Smelt ore into metal in your furnace
Pour metal into egg moulds and wait for them to cool and hatch
Hatched pets boost mining speed so you reach rarer ores
ideas.twist: Mix two metals in one mould for a chance at hybrid pets that only exist in the alloy index.
ideas.why_now: Forge × eggs is an open gap (score 5.78). Break/mine is the top rising mechanic at 3.07× and break × hatch is a proven pair (6 young games, 198.6K CCU: Dig For Eggs 10.3K, (🩸) Drill for Eggs 21.5K). Forge/craft is rising at 1.69× and "___ for ___" is the hottest title formula at 4.04×.
ideas.differentiator: Dig-for-eggs games find eggs in the ground; here you make the egg yourself, and the recipe gives you control over what hatches.
